title: introduce-stable-seed-anchored-baseline-reconciler-and-traffic-aware-smoke-sentinel
author: Amir Navarro
description: Motivation: intermittent, non-deterministic prompt-set regressions have been difficult to triage because changing request traffic mix amplifies or suppresses regressions. This PR introduces a seed-anchored baseline reconciler that pins a stable RNG seed and a compact canonical snapshot for each prompt-set cohort, plus a traffic-aware smoke sentinel that weights smoke-eval signals by recent production traffic distribution. The reconciler writes compact baseline artifacts to the artifact-store and exposes a reconcile command used by CI to produce a stable delta summary. The smoke sentinel is a CI hook that mirrors a small, weighted sample of recent traffic into the eval harness and gates PRs when traffic-weighted degradation exceeds configured thresholds. Key goals: 1) make regression signals reproducible across reruns, 2) reduce noise from rare-traffic outliers, 3) provide compact, actionable delta reports suitable for code reviewers. This change is opt-in via eval config flags and defaults to disabled for existing pipelines to avoid accidental gate flips. Implementation notes: light-weight reconciliation algorithm, deterministic seeding for batching and sampling, traffic-weighted scoring that normalizes by cohort frequency, and a compact delta report generator with per-prompt examples and token-level attribution hints. Related work: builds on ideas from ENG-7261 (stable-seed utilities) and complements existing anchor/replay features but focuses on traffic-weighted gating rather than strict anchor mirroring. Checklist: - [x] baseline snapshot API and serializer - [x] reconciler CLI with --artifact-path support - [x] CI hook and GitHub Actions workflow for traffic-weighted mirroring - [x] unit and integration tests - [x] documentation and runbook - [x] performance sanity checks to keep per-eval cost low Backwards compatibility: configuration is additive and disabled by default, no runtime changes to existing production instrumentation. Rollout: start with shadow runs on release branch, then enable gate for low-risk repos.

review_conversation: Leah Moreno (reviewer): This is a great direction for reducing noisy regressions. A couple of asks: (1) Can we ensure the baseline serializer is compact and contains checksums to detect drift? (2) Please add a short note about privacy for mirrored traffic.

Amir Navarro (author): Added checksum metadata and truncated example contexts to the serializer, and added an explicit privacy note in docs to redact PII before mirroring. See reconciler/stable_baseline.py changes.

Jasper Liu (reviewer): Tests look good but the traffic-weighting formula feels brittle for highly-skewed cohorts. Suggest adding a floor and cap to cohort weights and document the rationale. Also saw a lint error in uploader.py on the first CI run.
Amir Navarro (author): Implemented cap/floor at 0.01/0.5 in the weighting code and fixed linting issues. Added a short appendix in reconciliation.md explaining the tradeoffs.
Nina Patel (approver): Verified integration against a mirrored snapshot and the delta reporting was actionable. Approving pending green CI.

Final CI status: all checks passed. Detailed checks: unit-tests: pass, integration-tests: pass, lint: pass, smoke-workflow: pass, flake8: pass.
release_notes: Adds an opt-in Stable Seed Baseline reconciler plus a traffic-weighted smoke sentinel CI hook. Provides reproducible delta reports for prompt-set regression triage and enables traffic-aware gating. Disabled by default; configuration and runbook included.
notes_for_ops: Artifact storage should be configured with lifecycle policies; reconciler writes small JSON snapshots (~10-50KB per cohort). Start with shadow runs on canary repos and monitor smoke false-positive rate for two weeks.
changelog_entry: Opt-in traffic-weighted smoke sentinel and StableSeedBaseline reconciler for reproducible prompt-set regression detection.
